title: Long inputs in PowerToys Run cause the grey preview text to not line up.
summary: PowerToys Run autocomplete preview overlaps or misaligns when a long query scrolls.

judgment.rationale: Multiple historical reports and the current separate text surfaces support a specific scroll synchronization investigation; current behavior is not reproduced in this pass.
evidence: The original 0.47 report describes a horizontally scrolling long input with the gray autocomplete preview left at the beginning; a contributor called it easily reproduced.
Later reports describe the issue through 0.76 and in Shell and Web Search suggestions.
LauncherControl.xaml places the query TextBox with PART_ContentHost ScrollViewer and a separate AutoCompleteTextBlock in the same grid cell; no synchronization is visible there.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce long suggestions on a current build and evaluate a scroll-aligned preview design without changing completion behavior.

fix_assessment.rationale: A scroll-aligned autocomplete preview is a plausible targeted correction, subject to current reproduction and design review.

proposed_fixes.title: Align Run autocomplete with the query viewport
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the separate autocomplete TextBlock does not follow the query TextBox horizontal viewport when long text scrolls.
plan: Reproduce the long-query overlap on a current build and measure the query viewport and preview placement.
Design synchronized scrolling and clipping for the preview using the TextBox content viewport, including caret movement and resizing.
Keep autocomplete selection, accessibility, theme resources and plugin-provided suggestion semantics unchanged.
Add focused coverage for long and short strings, navigation, resizing, high DPI and right-to-left flow.
verification: The ghost suggestion aligns with the scrolled query and remains clipped to the input area.
Autocomplete acceptance, selection and screen-reader access continue working across left-to-right and right-to-left layouts.

confidence.rationale: The report has repeated confirmations and source contains separate scrolling and preview surfaces, but current behavior and an acceptable synchronization design require validation.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run autocomplete preview overlaps or misaligns when a long query scrolls.
known_information: The original 0.47 report describes a horizontally scrolling long input with the gray autocomplete preview left at the beginning; a contributor called it easily reproduced.
Later reports describe the issue through 0.76 and in Shell and Web Search suggestions.
inferences: A separate preview surface not following the TextBox viewport is consistent with the symptom; other alignment factors remain possible.
initial_investigation: Inspected src/modules/launcher/PowerLauncher/LauncherControl.xaml and MainWindow.xaml.cs: the query has a scrolling TextBox template and autocomplete is rendered in a separate TextBlock.
Reviewed complete thread and cross-references; no active assignee or covering fix appears in the issue timeline.
Searched current upstream PR titles for suggestion/scroll work without finding an established covering change.
issue_context.analysis: The available evidence points to a rendering boundary and supports a maintainer reproduction before choosing a synchronized viewport design.

information_gaps.information: Whether and how the autocomplete preview diverges from the query viewport on a current build, including caret movement and RTL.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines the appropriate synchronization and clipping semantics and prevents regressions.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Maintainer tests long suggestions, horizontal scrolling, selection and RTL layout while comparing textbox offset to preview placement.

reproduce.title: Compare query and suggestion viewport
reproduce.version_requirement: Use the current PowerToys release; historical reports include 0.47 through 0.76.
prerequisites: Use a Windows machine with PowerToys Run and a plugin that offers autocomplete, such as Registry or Shell.
setup: Enable suggestions and choose a long query that yields a matching autocomplete suggestion.
steps: 1. Open Run and enter a suggestion-producing query until the input scrolls horizontally.
2. Compare the gray preview and typed text while adding and deleting characters.
3. Move the caret, select text and resize the Run window; repeat in a right-to-left interface where available.
4. In a maintainer diagnostic session, compare the query content host horizontal offset and preview placement.
reproduce.expected_result: The gray completion aligns to the typed text within the query viewport throughout scrolling and editing.
